row.proto: void Sess_Issue_TimePenalty(void *rules, uint8_t *incident, uint32_t reason, uint32_t seconds)
row.notes: Issue a time penalty: param_2 = infringement record (byte car +0, lap +9, +0x14), param_3 = reason byte, param_4 = seconds. Online games may scale the seconds (x g 0x145f96748, msg 0x14584ee80 on [[rules+0x1cd0]+0xa0]+0x3d0). Converts to a pit-served penalty when the car's race record ([rules+0x1c68]+0x148[car]) allows; records it (0x1435668e0 / 0x143573400 with the penalty kind, reason, seconds, lap), posts bus msg 0x14584ec18 (car, kind, reason) and, for a local human car, shows it on the HUD ([rules+0x1c18]+0xa0: +0x1104 = seconds, UI event 0x145849882). Callers 0x14356cc29, 0x14356d66e and tail jumps 0x143571af8, 0x14357371e..0x143573748. (used by vmknolle track-limits)

verify.notes: V1047 logs 'Car %d ISSUE %d SECOND PENALTY' with arg4, adds arg4*k to the vehicle's accumulated penalty time, records penalty type 4 (time penalty; 0x12 variant), radio 'TimePenalties'; 4 args (rules, incident*, reason, seconds) match
